integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide shot frames an elegant ancient Chinese woman in a flowing white hanfu with jade-green accents standing beside a moonlit riverside pavilion at night, soft mist drifting across the water, warm lantern light glowing behind her. She holds a closed folding fan in her left hand, a jade hairpin securing her dark hair, a gentle breeze stirring her sleeves. The camera holds an almost static shot with a push in of small amplitude at slow speed as she (S1) lifts her chin and begins singing along with the pre-locked vocal track, her lips moving in precise sync with the melody while her right hand rises gracefully to trace the air beside her cheek. As the melody swells, she slowly lowers her hand to her chest, tilts her head slightly, and gazes toward the distant moon over the water, her brows softly furrowed with emotion. The camera continues its subtle push in as she turns her gaze back toward the lens, holds the final phrase with a faint, tender smile, and lets her lips close gently as the vocal fades out at the end of the shot.

overall_soundscape: A gentle night breeze rustles the bamboo and reeds along the riverbank while water laps softly against the pavilion pillars. Her silk sleeves swish faintly as she moves, and her breathing deepens slightly between phrases.
